sql: SELECT p.id,p.market_ticker,p.strategy,p.created_at,p.side,p.assumed_price,p.quantity,p.status,p.pnl,p.fees,p.closed_at,p.experiment_deployment_arm_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM live_paper_twins t WHERE t.twin_tag=p.strategy) AS is_twin FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND p.status IN ('settled','closed_sl') ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 200
